verdict.rationale: Every Greptile review comment has a "Fix with your Agent" button, and the review summary has a "Fix All" button. These send the issue, with file paths, line numbers and suggested code, to Claude Code, Codex, Conductor, Cursor or Devin, so an agent-generated follow-up can be launched in one click from the PR. MCP commands (/check-pr, /greploop) also let an agent fetch and fix unaddressed comments iteratively. missing for 10: native one-click committable patch/suggestion applied directly in the PR (fixes depend on third-party agents), evidence of how the agent's fix lands back on the PR branch, independent hands-on corroboration of the fix flow.
